fact: On 17 April 2025 the Ministry of Justice announced that civil registrars named in March 2025 for the other district capitals, beyond the usual ones of Bata and Malabo, would begin operating shortly, the first offices opening that week on the island; the text says nothing of digital entry.
title: Justicia anuncia la activación de las oficinas del Registro Civil en todos los distritos de Guinea Ecuatorial
